title: Amortized Inference for Correlated Discrete Choice Models via Equivariant Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2603.24705v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Discrete choice models are fundamental tools in management science, economics, and marketing for understanding and predicting decision-making. Logit-based models are dominant in applied work, largely due to their convenient closed-form expressions for choice probabilities. However, they impose restrictive assumptions on the stochastic utility component, constraining our ability to capture realistic substitution patterns. We propose an amortized inference approach that relies on a neural network emulator to approximate choice probabilities for general error distributions, including those with correlated errors. We develop a specialized neural network architecture designed to respect the invariance properties of discrete choice models. translated_title: 基于等变神经网络的关联离散选择模型的摊销推断
translated_abstract: 离散选择模型是管理科学、经济学和市场营销中用于理解和预测决策行为的基础工具。基于Logit的模型在实际应用中占据主导地位，这主要归功于其选择概率具有便捷的闭式表达式。然而，这些模型对随机效用成分施加了严格的假设，限制了模型捕捉现实替代模式的能力。我们提出了一种摊销推断方法，该方法依赖神经网络模拟器来逼近一般误差分布（包括误差相关的分布）下的选择概率。我们设计了一种专门的神经网络架构，使其符合离散选择模型的等变性/不变性性质，并为该架构提供了群论基础，包括基于最小不变特征集的万能逼近定理证明。模型训练完成后，该模拟器能够实现快速的似然评估（摘要原文此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于等变神经网络架构的摊销推断方法，可为具有相关误差的一般离散选择模型快速逼近选择概率与似然函数，突破了传统Logit模型对随机效用分布的严格假设限制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an amortized inference approach based on equivariant neural network architectures that rapidly approximates choice probabilities and likelihoods for general discrete choice models with correlated errors, overcoming the restrictive distributional assumptions of traditional logit models.
